tagline: Transforming rural India through clean water, education, healthcare and women empowerment.
hero_subheadline: Delivering clean water, education, healthcare and women empowerment across 200+ villages in rural India.
mission_text: HopeForward was born from a simple belief: every child deserves clean water to drink, every family deserves access to healthcare, and every woman deserves the tools to build financial independence. We operate on the ground in Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Madhya Pradesh.
program_1_title: Jal Jeevan — Water for Every Village
program_1_description: Building bore wells, rain-water harvesting systems and water purification units across arid villages.
program_2_description: Bridging learning gaps with community schools, digital classrooms and mid-day meal programs.
program_3_description: Bringing doctors to doorsteps through solar-powered mobile health units visiting 20 villages weekly.
program_4_description: Vocational training, microfinance access and SHG formation for 4,200+ rural women.
testimonial_quote: I completed the Shakti skill program and started my own tailoring shop. In eight months I paid back my loan and hired two women from my village.
team_1_bio: Former IAS officer with 18 years in rural development policy. Founded HopeForward in 2013.
team_2_bio: IIM Ahmedabad alumnus. Oversees ground operations across 4 states and 60 field teams.
team_3_bio: Social work PhD from TISS Mumbai. Designed the Shakti women empowerment curriculum.
address: 42 Mahatma Gandhi Road, Connaught Place, New Delhi 110 001

tagline: Healthcare access and dignity for remote villages.
hero_subheadline: Mobile clinics, maternal health camps and medicine access for families living far from city hospitals.
mission_text: Rural Care Foundation works with local health workers, doctors and village leaders to bring preventive care, maternal support and early diagnosis to communities that are usually left waiting.
program_1_description: Weekly doctor visits, diagnostics and essential medicines delivered through mobile vans.
program_2_description: Nutrition counseling, pregnancy checkups and safe-delivery referrals for expecting mothers.
program_3_description: Training village volunteers to identify health risks early and support referrals.
program_4_description: Subsidized chronic-care medicines for elders and low-income families.
testimonial_quote: The clinic van reached our village when my mother needed help. The team checked her sugar levels and arranged treatment before it became serious.
team_1_bio: Public health physician leading rural clinic operations and clinical quality.
team_2_bio: Coordinates mobile van routes, health workers and district partnerships.
team_3_bio: Designs maternal health and awareness programs with village volunteers.

tagline: Learning spaces for every child in underserved communities.
hero_subheadline: Community learning centers, girls' scholarships and digital classrooms for children across underserved districts.
mission_text: Shiksha Sewa Trust partners with teachers, parents and local youth mentors to help first-generation learners stay in school, read confidently and prepare for better futures.
program_1_description: After-school learning centers that strengthen reading, math and confidence.
program_2_description: Tablet-based lessons and teacher tools for rural classrooms.
program_3_description: Scholarships, mentoring and family counseling to keep girls in school.
program_4_description: Mobile libraries bringing storybooks and learning kits to villages.
testimonial_quote: My daughter used to be afraid of reading aloud. After six months at the learning center, she reads stories to her younger brother every evening.
team_1_bio: Education entrepreneur focused on first-generation learners and girls' retention.
team_2_bio: Former school principal designing remedial learning curriculum.
team_3_bio: Builds school partnerships, mentor networks and donor reporting systems.
